mapper.select:
select sa.id, sa.principal, rm.id roleId, rm.role_name roleName, d.id departmentId, d.department_name departmentName, menu_id menuId, menu_name menuName from sys_auth sa left join user_department ud on sa.id = ud.user_id and ud.del_flag = 0 left join department d on ud.department_id = d.id left join user_role_relation urr on urr.user_id = sa.id and urr.del_flag = 0 left join role_main rm on rm.id = urr.role_id left join role_menu_relation rmr on rmr.role_id = rm.id and rmr.del_flag = 0 left join menu_info mi on mi.id = rmr.menu_id where sa.status = 1 and sa.del_flag = 0
and sa.id = #{authId}
